scenario.description: A tech lead must finalize the work package for the next sprint's technical-debt effort, including the selected workstreams, implementation approaches, delivery dates, and required follow-up commitments, after the team's routine planning review.

shared_context.S1: The next sprint has capacity for three technical-debt workstreams.
shared_context.S2: The candidate workstreams are queue replay reliability, administrator export maintenance, and service-secret rotation.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to publish the final sprint debt plan and assign the required follow-up work.
shared_context.S4: The team's normal debt-planning routine includes a final review by backend engineering, customer support, and security before Maya locks the plan.

PF1.text: While fixing an unrelated queue-consumer issue yesterday, Leo found that queue replay currently depends on an undocumented shortcut that skips idempotency checks; the sprint plan must replace that shortcut with an idempotent replay path and reserve five engineering days for it, but he has not filed the finding yet.

PF2.text: Nina confirmed with the account team this morning that the Northstar contract requires administrator exports to support resumable downloads by October 18, and Northstar needs a migration notice before the change; she has not updated the debt-planning ticket yet.

PF3.text: During a routine access review today, Omar confirmed that the service-secret rotation work must produce an immutable evidence record retained for 365 days to satisfy the next compliance audit; he has not opened the audit follow-up yet.

acceptance_conditions: All three named debt workstreams must be selected.
The queue-replay plan must replace the undocumented shortcut with an idempotent replay path.
The queue replay work must reserve exactly five engineering days.
Administrator export work must be due by October 18.
Northstar must receive a migration notice.
Secret-rotation evidence must be stored as an immutable evidence record.
Secret-rotation evidence must be retained for exactly 365 days.
The plan must include a follow-up commitment assigned to Leo for the queue-replay finding.
The plan must include a Northstar migration-notice commitment or set the Northstar migration-notice decision to true.
The plan must include a follow-up commitment assigned to Omar for the immutable audit-evidence requirement.
The undocumented queue-replay shortcut must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: len(decisions['selected_workstreams']) == 3 and 'queue replay reliability' in decisions['selected_workstreams'] and 'administrator export maintenance' in decisions['selected_workstreams'] and 'service-secret rotation' in decisions['selected_workstreams']
content_checks.C6: decisions['secret_evidence_storage'] == 'Immutable evidence record' or decisions['secret_evidence_storage'] == 'Immutable evidence record with retention storage'
content_checks.C9: any(c['target'] == 'Leo' and c['type'] == 'follow-up' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['target'] == 'Omar' and c['type'] == 'follow-up' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The undocumented shortcut changes queue replay from a generic reliability task to an idempotent replay path with exactly five engineering days and a follow-up commitment assigned to Leo.
The Northstar contract changes administrator export from an undated maintenance item to work due by exactly October 18 with the Northstar migration-notice decision set to true.
The audit requirement changes secret rotation from a generic completion task to an immutable evidence record retained for exactly 365 days with a follow-up commitment assigned to Omar.
